name: Vinted
description: Search Vinted's second-hand fashion marketplace from any AI assistant: find items by text, category, brand, size, condition, colour and price, and look up the filter IDs to do it. 3 tools, no account or API key — Vinted's own website API with an anonymous session token fetched automatically.
instructions:
This connector uses the internal API behind the Vinted website (api.vinted.fr). Vinted has no official public API for the catalog: this is the one its own web app calls, it is undocumented, and Vinted changes it without notice (in September 2026 it retired www.vinted.fr/api/v2/catalog/items, which is why earlier versions of this connector failed on every call).

**Setup**: nothing to enter. On the first call the connector requests https://www.vinted.fr/catalog once, keeps the anonymous `access_token_web` session cookie Vinted hands to every visitor, and sends it as a bearer token. The token lasts 24 hours; the connector renews it on its own, and again whenever Vinted answers 401.

**Workflow**:
1. Optional: `vinted_get_categories` for category IDs and `vinted_get_filters` (filter_code = brand, size, status, color or material) for the IDs of brands, sizes, conditions, colours and materials, with item counts for the current search.
2. `vinted_search_items` with `search_text` and any of those IDs (comma-separated for several).

**Condition IDs** (`status_ids`): 6 new with tags, 1 new without tags, 2 very good, 3 good, 4 satisfactory.

**Limits**:
- Read-only: no buying, messaging, favourites or listing. Those need a logged-in Vinted account and happen in the Vinted app.
- One market: the catalog is served for vinted.fr, prices are in EUR, titles and filter names are in French. Items listed in other EU markets appear too.
- A search reaches at most 960 items (e.g. 10 pages of 96); narrow it with filters rather than paging further. `total_entries` is capped at 960 for the same reason.
- Size IDs depend on the category: pass `catalog_ids` to `vinted_get_filters` with filter_code=size, or the answer lists every size chart (about 30 KB).
- Unofficial: if Vinted moves the endpoint or blocks the session request, calls fail with 401/403/404 until the connector is updated. Use it for occasional lookups, in line with Vinted's terms, not for bulk collection.

**Suggested starter prompts**:
- "Find Stone Island jackets size L under €150 on Vinted, newest first."
- "Search Vinted for 'Carhartt WIP' trousers in very good condition."
- "Which brands have the most 'veste en jean' listings on Vinted right now?"

tools.name: vinted_search_items
tools.description: Search Vinted's catalog by free text, with optional category, brand, size, condition, colour, material and price filters. Returns up to 96 items per page with id, title, brand, size and condition, price and price with buyer fees (EUR), link, main photo and seller.

search_text.description: Free-text query (e.g. 'Stone Island jacket', 'Carhartt WIP trousers').

page.description: Page number. A search reaches at most 960 items in total.

catalog_ids.description: Optional comma-separated category IDs from vinted_get_categories (e.g. '5' men, '1904' women).

brand_ids.description: Optional comma-separated brand IDs from vinted_get_filters (filter_code=brand), e.g. '362' Carhartt.

size_ids.description: Optional comma-separated size IDs from vinted_get_filters (filter_code=size). Size IDs depend on the category.

status_ids.description: Optional condition filter, comma-separated: '6' new with tags, '1' new without tags, '2' very good, '3' good, '4' satisfactory.

color_ids.description: Optional comma-separated colour IDs from vinted_get_filters (filter_code=color), e.g. '1' black.

material_ids.description: Optional comma-separated material IDs from vinted_get_filters (filter_code=material).

transform.expression: {pagination: pagination.{current_page: current_page, per_page: per_page, total_pages: total_pages, total_entries: total_entries}, items: items[].{id: id, title: title, brand: item_box.first_line, size_and_condition: item_box.second_line, price: price.amount, total_price_with_fees: total_item_price.amount, currency: price.currency_code, url: join('', ['https://www.vinted.fr', url]), photo: photo.url, seller: user.login, favourites: favourite_count, promoted: promoted}}

tools.name: vinted_get_filters
tools.description: List the options of one Vinted search filter — brand, size, status (condition), color or material — with their IDs and how many items match, for an optional search text and category. Use the IDs in vinted_search_items.

search_text.description: Optional: count options for this query (e.g. 'veste en jean').

catalog_ids.description: Optional comma-separated category IDs from vinted_get_categories (e.g. '5' men, '1904' women). Recommended for filter_code=size, whose options depend on the category.

transform.expression: {filter_code: filter_code, options: options[].{id: id, title: title, items_count: items_count, options: options[].{id: id, title: title, items_count: items_count, options: options[].{id: id, title: title, items_count: items_count}}}}

tools.name: vinted_get_categories
tools.description: List Vinted categories with their IDs and item counts, for an optional search text. Pass a category ID in catalog_ids to get its subcategories. Use the IDs as catalog_ids in vinted_search_items and vinted_get_filters.

search_text.description: Optional: count items per category for this query.

catalog_ids.description: Optional category ID whose subcategories to list (e.g. '5' men, '1904' women).

transform.expression: categories[].{id: id, title: title, item_count: item_count, url: join('', ['https://www.vinted.fr', url])}
